purpose: Discover zero-cost independent suppliers that can decode/inspect a generated barcode image, so auto-acquired producers cannot self-certify semantic correctness.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path("canonical/runtime/capability_discovery.py")
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("capability_discovery_probe",p)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
out=m.search_all("decode barcode image",limit_per_source=30)
path=pathlib.Path("canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-BARCODE-SEMANTIC-VERIFIER-DISCOVERY-001__RESULT.json")
path.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print("BARCODE_VERIFIER_DISCOVERY_COMPLETE",json.dumps([
 {"name":x.get("name"),"source":x.get("discovery_source"),"score":x.get("score"),
  "friction":x.get("integration_friction"),"description":x.get("description"),
  "version":x.get("version"),"archive_sha256":x.get("archive_sha256")}
 for x in out.get("candidates",[])[:20]
],sort_keys=True))
PY
